uv run python -u -c 
import os, httpx, sys
url = 'https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fninf.2016.00017/pdf'
email = os.environ.get('SCHOLAR_EMAIL', 'a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk')
headers = {'User-Agent': f'add-paper/1.0 (mailto:{email})'}
out = 'tasks/t0097_multi_obj_optim/assets/paper/10.3389_fninf.2016.00017/files/vangeit_2016_bluepyopt.pdf'
with httpx.Client(headers=headers, follow_redirects=True, timeout=60) as c:
    r = c.get(url)
    print('status:', r.status_code, 'content-type:', r.headers.get('content-type'), 'size:', len(r.content))
    if r.status_code == 200 and r.content[:5] == b'%PDF-':
        with open(out, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(r.content)
        print('Saved to', out)
    else:
        print('First 200 bytes:', r.content[:200])
